verdict.rationale: Fathom has a public pricing page that lists features such as unlimited recordings, CRM field sync, coaching scorecards and SSO & SCIM, and its docs say API access is included on all plans, so multiple self-serve plans appear to exist. But the evidence never shows a free tier, any prices, which features belong to which tier, or whether higher tiers require contacting sales. missing for 10: an evidenced free plan, published per-tier prices, a feature-to-tier mapping, and confirmation that no tier sits behind a sales wall.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start free and see exactly what each paid tier costs and adds — no "talk to sales" wall for basic use
